questions.text: Differentiate between growth and development. Describe briefly the different periods of human development.
Define infancy period. Elaborate the main components of language development.
Write an essay on physical development of the children during early school years.
What do you understand by learning disabilities? Discuss characteristics and causes of learning disabilities.
Define and describe the period of adolescence. What are the changes that occur in males during this period?
Discuss the information processing approach to cognitive development during adolescence.
What are the high risk behaviours? Give suitable examples and discuss the remedial measures and preventive measures for adolescents.
Discuss critically the cognitive changes in early and middle adulthood.
Explain stage versus life events approach. Discuss the psycho-social changes that occur during old-age.
Process of Assimilation and Accommodation in Piaget's theory of cognitive development.
